name: Every Theta Class Is Peripheral
statement: A finite partial cube is a daisy cube exactly when every $\Theta$-class $E_x$ is peripheral: for at least one side $\epsilon\in\{0,1\}$, the boundary $U_x^\epsilon$ equals the whole semicube $W_x^\epsilon$.
hypotheses: Finite partial cube; no root or hypercube embedding is chosen.
recognition_complexity: $O(n^2)$ on an arbitrary $n$-vertex input, including construction of a proper down-set labelling when the test succeeds.
